message: Live frame analysis completed with OpenAI vision.

spec.workflowSummary: A clinic admin qualifies a new patient inquiry from WhatsApp, records appointment details in a spreadsheet-style tracker, assigns doctor and slot, then copies a confirmation message back to WhatsApp and marks the appointment status.

sourceEvidence.observation: WhatsApp card titled "New patient inquiry" shows: "Priya: Need a skin consultation tomorrow" and "Admin asks: name, age, phone, preferred time".

Google Sheets card titled "Copy patient details into appointment..." shows columns: "Name | Phone | Concern | Doctor | Slot | Status" and example row: "Priya Nair | 9876522211 | Acne | Dr Mehta | 10:30 | Pend...".

WhatsApp card titled "Send confirmation message" shows message text beginning: "Hi Priya, your appointment is booked with Dr Mehta..." and the side note indicates using a template/copy message and marking status.

steps.title: Receive patient inquiry in WhatsApp
steps.input: Patient sends a consultation request, e.g. skin consultation tomorrow.
steps.output: Admin identifies the patient request and asks for required details: name, age, phone, preferred time.

steps.title: Record appointment details
steps.input: Collected patient name, phone, concern, doctor, slot, and current status.
steps.output: A new appointment row is created or updated in the tracker.

steps.title: Send appointment confirmation
steps.input: Booked appointment details including patient name, doctor, and slot.
steps.output: Admin copies a confirmation message to WhatsApp and updates the appointment status.

entities.name: appointment
entities.label: Appointment
entities.description: A patient consultation request and booking tracked from WhatsApp inquiry through confirmation.

painPoints: Patient details are manually collected in WhatsApp and copied into a spreadsheet.
Appointment status must be manually tracked after sending the confirmation message.
Confirmation text is manually typed or copied, creating risk of inconsistent messages.

messageTemplates.name: Ask for patient details
messageTemplates.body: Hi {{patient_name}}, please share your name, age, phone number, and preferred time for the consultation.

messageTemplates.name: Appointment confirmation
messageTemplates.body: Hi {{patient_name}}, your appointment is booked with {{doctor}} at {{slot}}.

screens.name: New Appointment Form
screens.description: Enter details collected from a WhatsApp patient inquiry: name, age, phone, concern, preferred time, doctor, slot, and status.

screens.name: Appointment Tracker
screens.description: Spreadsheet-style list with columns for Name, Phone, Concern, Doctor, Slot, and Status.

screens.name: Appointment Detail
screens.description: View and edit one patient appointment and copy the confirmation message.

screens.name: Message Templates
screens.description: Copyable WhatsApp message templates for asking details and confirming a booked appointment.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should the status list include only Pending and Booked for the MVP?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Yes, use only Pending and Booked because those are supported by the frames.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should doctor names be free text or selected from a fixed list?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Use free text for MVP; only Dr Mehta appears in the frames.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should slot be stored as free text or a time field?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Use free text for MVP because the frame shows a simple slot value like 10:30.
